title: Next Stop, Little Shop
subtitle: Ikebukuro · Lifestyle Select Shop
normalNote: One real day = one game day · local clock
welcome: Start with your own little shop
name: Shop name
tutorial1: Choose something you like and buy a few.
tutorial2: Choose a display for an item you have in stock.
tutorial3: Check your prices, then open your shop.
tutorial4: Your first sale is in. Read the report, then reveal the sample.
revealed: Tutorial sample · No business bonuses · Not a canon story item
accounting: Stock purchases become inventory cost. Only the cost of goods sold is charged to profit, so it is not counted twice. Reports follow Tokyo dates.
prototypeNote: Prototype saves stay in this browser; no production-account transfer promised. Balance, art and translations await review.
camera: Drag to orbit · wheel / pinch to zoom · tap displays
loadError: Loading failed. Refresh; keep or export your existing save.
stale: Another tab updated this save. Reload to continue.
rollback: Clock moved backwards. Settlement pauses until it catches up.
long_gap: Gap exceeds 31 days. Catch up one day at a time; earnings are not silently discarded.
invalid: Invalid save or input. Existing save was preserved.
cashError: Not enough cash for this purchase.
recovery: Keep this page to export the raw save, or refresh to retry.
modeHelp: Normal and Sandbox have separate saves. Switching preserves both. You can fast-forward only in the Sandbox.
replacedNote: Replacing a display keeps the previous goods in inventory.
noStock: Buy stock first, then display it.
quantityError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000. Each product can hold up to 100,000 units.
nextBuy: Choose something you like and buy a few.
nextDisplay: Once an item is in stock, choose its display on the product card.
nextOpen: Check your prices, then open your shop.
nextSale: Stocked items sell during opening hours. In the sandbox, advance one hour to check the result.
nextReveal: Your first sale is in. Read the report, then reveal the sample.
completeTitle: Your shop is finding its rhythm
completeNote: You have bought stock, arranged a display, made your first sale and opened the tutorial sample. Restock, adjust prices or take a moment to enjoy your shop.
recoveryNote: Free provisional support for shops with no stock and too little cash to buy one item. Recorded separately from sales/profit. Rent continues to accrue.
supportReceived: Support recorded. Buy 5 pencils, then display them.
storage: This action could not be saved. Keep this page and export a backup or retry. You can then repeat the action if needed.
noWebGL: 3D could not start in this browser. Shop controls and saves still work. Use a WebGL-capable browser to see the shop.
recovery_ineligible: Support is not currently needed. Use your existing cash or stock.
command_limit: The prototype command limit is reached. Time settlement remains available; export a backup.
discovery_locked: Make your first sale before revealing the sample.
emptyReport: No activity recorded for this day yet.
identityError: Enter a shop name (1–32 characters), company (up to 32) and mark (up to 4).
displayEmptyError: Buy stock before placing goods on a display.
minimalFXNote: Disable dust, glow and decorative movement; keep customer walking and staff work / transaction responses. Reduce Motion is separate. Saved on this device; shop rules stay the same.
